title.quote: Effective Latent Differential Equation Models via Attention and Multiple Shooting
title.justification: Title as given on the paper.
title.value: Effective Latent Differential Equation Models via Attention and Multiple Shooting

extractions.description: The paper introduces GOKU-UI, an enhancement of GOKU-nets (latent differential equation generative models) adding attention mechanisms and a latent-space multiple shooting training strategy, implemented in Julia's SciML ecosystem. It is evaluated on synthetic data from coupled stochastic Stuart-Landau oscillators and on empirical resting-state fMRI data from the Track-On HD study, compared against LSTM, Latent ODE and naive baselines in reconstruction and forecast tasks.

type.quote: These modifications have led to a significant increase in its performance in both reconstruction and forecast tasks, as demonstrated by our evaluation of simulated and empirical data.
type.justification: The work is evaluated through experiments on simulated and empirical datasets.
